number.why: The source reports HR 0.70 (95% CI 0.59–0.82) for canagliflozin versus placebo for the primary cardiorenal composite. The registry independently confirms this estimate and the all-randomized ITT population. The reported 2.62 years is median follow-up at early trial termination; the registry outcome window is up to 4.6 years.

quotes.span: The primary outcome was a composite of end-stage kidney disease (dialysis, transplantation, or a sustained estimated GFR of <15 ml per minute per 1.73 m2), a doubling of the serum creatinine level, or death from renal or cardiovascular causes.

The relative risk of the primary outcome was 30% lower in the canagliflozin group than in the placebo group, with event rates of 43.2 and 61.2 per 1000 patient-years, respectively (hazard ratio, 0.70; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.59 to 0.82; P = 0.00001).
RESULT OUTCOME 0 ANALYSIS 0: groups Placebo, Canagliflozin 100 mg | Hazard Ratio (HR) 0.70 (95% CI 0.59 to 0.82) | p < 0.0001 | METHOD Cox Proportional Hazard
TIME FRAME: Up to 4.6 years | POPULATION: The Intent-to-treat (ITT) population consisted of all randomized participants.

The trial was stopped early after a planned interim analysis on the recommendation of the data and safety monitoring committee. At that time, 4401 patients had undergone randomization, with a median follow-up of 2.62 years.

entry.why: The trial establishes adult CKD entry, SGLT2 inhibitor versus placebo, and double-blind randomization. Its population is specifically adults with type 2 diabetes and albuminuric CKD, which meets the question's entry criteria without establishing applicability to every CKD subgroup.

quotes.span: In this double-blind, randomized trial, we assigned patients with type 2 diabetes and albuminuric chronic kidney disease to receive canagliflozin, an oral SGLT2 inhibitor, at a dose of 100 mg daily or placebo.
ELIGIBILITY AGE/SEX: minimum age 30 Years | maximum age None | sex ALL

missed: Nothing changes either verdict. The follow-up metadata should distinguish median follow-up of 2.62 years from the registry window of up to 4.6 years, as quoted above.
